summary:
Buy 31 ceiling air devices, in three families, plus 3 ceiling exhaust fans.

CEILING SUPPLY DIFFUSERS - 28 total, all Price, white finish, 4-way throw, w/ radial balancing damper in the neck (Price VCR9) and factory-insulated backpan:
- Type A - Price SCD, 6" round neck in 24x24 lay-in panel: 5 ea (75, 75, 75, 90, 130 CFM)
- Type B - Price SCD, 8" round neck in 24x24 lay-in panel: 4 ea (150, 150, 140, 140 CFM)
- Type C - Price SCD, 10" round neck in 24x24 lay-in panel: 15 ea (250, 200, 250, 250, 250, 200, 350, 350, 350, 300, 375, 375, 300, 375, 375 CFM)
- Type D - Price SCD, 12" round neck in 24x24 lay-in panel: 1 ea (500 CFM)
A-D are louvered-face square 4-cone steel diffusers, 360-degree fixed discharge, full-faced louvers.
- Type J - Price SMD, 12x12 face w/ 8" round neck, flanged frame for SURFACE mounting (hard ceiling, not lay-in), w/ opposed-blade damper: 3 ea (175, 150, 150 CFM)
Ceiling supply total = 6,550 CFM.

CEILING RETURN / EXHAUST GRILLES:
- Type F - Price 80, 24" x 24" core-only panel for lay-in ceiling, 1/2" x 1/2" x 1/2" all-aluminum egg crate, white: 3 ea. One of these gets a new 24x24 lined plenum over it (note 4) and one gets a rect-to-round adapter (note 28).
- Plus 1 ea 14 x 14 egg crate, Price model 82, mounted in a SOFFIT with insect screen on the back (M101 keynote 19, outside-air intake). Untagged on the schedule - order separately.

CEILING EXHAUST FANS (integral grille - do NOT order a separate grille for these):
- EF-1 and EF-2: Greenheck SPA-700, 450 CFM ea, 0.30 in. w.g., 1100 RPM, 350 W, 2.5 sones
- EF-3: Greenheck SP-B90, 75 CFM, 0.25 in. w.g., 700 RPM, 50 W, 2.5 sones
All three are centrifugal ceiling fans w/ integral grille, flapper BD damper, plug/cord set, factory grille-mounted motion sensor, factory disconnect and speed controller.

NOT ceiling - these 15 are WALL-mounted and are on the same schedule, so don't let them get folded into the ceiling count: E (4 ea, Price 95, 30x18 primecoat return - field verify size before ordering), G (4 ea, Price 95, 36x36 primecoat sidewall transfer at 14'-8" AFF), H (3 ea, Price 520D, 18x8 primecoat sidewall supply, 550 CFM ea), I (4 ea, Price 520D, 14x8 primecoat sidewall supply, 450 CFM ea). Wall supply adds 3,450 CFM, so all new supply air on the job = 10,000 CFM.

Watch-outs: (1) E and I are flagged with an asterisk - field verify the exact grille dimension before ordering. (2) E, G, H and I are primecoat only and get 2 coats of field paint - confirm color with the architect. (3) Locations must be coordinated with the reflected ceiling plan (A6-1) for lights, sprinklers and grid; the J diffusers are surface-mount, so verify hard-ceiling vs. ACT before ordering frames. (4) Everything counted is new - MD101 shows the existing ceiling supply, sidewall supply, sidewall return and ceiling return grilles being removed and replaced, and the grilles marked "to remain" there are excluded.

Counted off M101 (Mechanical New Work Floor Plan); types, models and sizes from the GRILLES and EXHAUST FANS schedules on M601. Tally verified two ways: 46 lettered device tags by text, and 49 hexagon tag symbols by geometry (46 devices + 3 exhaust-fan CFM callouts).
